description: Pure SVG chart component supporting Bar, Line, Area, Pie, Donut, and HorizontalBar chart types with optional legend, grid, value labels, animation, gradient area fills, a proportional DateTime X axis for time series, combo charts (per-dataset ChartDataset.RenderAs = ChartDatasetRenderAs.Line renders that dataset as a line overlay over the bars of a Bar chart on a shared Y scale — bars for periodic flows, lines for cumulative values), dense-axis label thinning on Bar charts (over 24 categories only every n-th label renders), negative values on Bar/Line charts (signed domain with an emphasized zero axis; bars grow down from the zero baseline), point-marker thinning on dense line series (markers closer than ~9 units thin to ~24-unit spacing while the polyline stays complete), and click events on segments. Chart types additionally include Funnel (conversion trapezoids with per-stage conversion percentages), Heatmap (dataset-rows × label-columns intensity matrix with a global scale), Treemap (squarified shares, flat or hierarchical via ChartTreeNode), and Waterfall (the first value starts at zero and subsequent values are cumulative deltas, with optional connectors and calculated total). Stacked variants (StackedBar vertical, StackedHorizontalBar, StackedArea) accumulate each category's datasets on a shared baseline scaled to the largest stack total; non-positive values contribute nothing to a stack, datasets toggle off through the series legend, and bar value labels are omitted when a segment is too small to keep the text readable.

parameters.name: InteractiveLegend
parameters.description: When true, legend items become buttons that toggle the visibility of their series (multi-dataset legend) or single value (per-value legend). The component owns the hidden state; OnSeriesToggle reports each change. Default false keeps the legend non-interactive (backward compatible).

parameters.name: OnSeriesToggle
parameters.description: Raised whenever a legend series/value is toggled.

parameters.name: ShowTooltip
parameters.description: Shows a tooltip when hovering a bar, point or slice. Default true.

parameters.name: TooltipTemplate
parameters.description: Optional custom tooltip content; when null a rich default tooltip is used.

parameters.name: TreeNodes
parameters.description: Hierarchical data for ChartType.Treemap: top-level nodes render as groups with header strips, their children as tiles sized by value. When null, a treemap renders flat from Data (one tile per label/value).

parameters.name: AreaGradient
parameters.description: Area charts only: fills each series with a vertical gradient fading from the series color to transparent instead of the flat token-driven fill. Default false.

parameters.name: AreaOpacity
parameters.description: Area charts only: optional 0–1 opacity override for solid area fills. Null keeps the light/dark --tm-chart-area-fill-opacity design token; gradient areas retain their stop-based opacity.

parameters.name: WaterfallShowTotal
parameters.description: Waterfall charts only: appends a calculated total bar after the input values. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: WaterfallShowConnectors
parameters.description: Waterfall charts only: draws dashed cumulative-level connectors between adjacent bars. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: TimeLabelFormat
parameters.description: Time axis only: custom .NET date format string for the X-axis labels (e.g. "yyyy-MM"). Null picks the format automatically from the axis range (hours/days/months/years).

parameters.name: TimeAxisMin
parameters.description: Time axis only: lower bound of the X axis. Null uses the earliest data point.

parameters.name: TimeAxisMax
parameters.description: Time axis only: upper bound of the X axis. Null uses the latest data point.

examples.title: Basic bar chart
examples.code:
<TmChart Type="ChartType.Bar"
         Data="@(new ChartData { Labels = new[] { "Jan", "Feb", "Mar" }, Datasets = new[] { new ChartDataset { Label = "Sales", Values = new[] { 100.0, 200.0, 150.0 }, Color = "#3b82f6" } } })"
         Height="300px"
         ShowLegend="true"
         ShowGrid="true" />

examples.title: Per-value colors
examples.code:
<TmChart Type="ChartType.Donut"
         Data="@(new ChartData {
             Labels = new[] { "Critical", "High", "Medium", "Low", "Info" },
             Datasets = new[] {
                 new ChartDataset {
                     Label = "Outages",
                     Values = new[] { 5.0, 12.0, 25.0, 18.0, 7.0 },
                     Color = "#3b82f6",
                     BackgroundColors = new[] { "#dc2626", "#ea580c", "#2563eb", "#16a34a", "#64748b" }
                 }
             }
         })"
         Height="260px"
         ShowValues="true" />

examples.title: Area chart with gradient fill
examples.code:
<TmChart Type="ChartType.Area"
         Data="@(new ChartData { Labels = new[] { "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr" }, Datasets = new[] { new ChartDataset { Label = "Rent", Values = new[] { 15200.0, 15750.0, 15400.0, 16100.0 }, Color = "#3b82f6" } } })"
         AreaGradient="true"
         Height="300px" />

examples.title: Time series with a DateTime axis
examples.code:
<TmChart Type="ChartType.Line"
         Data="@(new ChartData { Labels = [], TimePoints = dates, Datasets = new[] { new ChartDataset { Label = "Price", Values = prices, Color = "#3b82f6" } } })"
         TimeLabelFormat="MMM yyyy"
         Height="320px" />

examples.title: Combo chart: bars with a line overlay (RenderAs)
examples.code:
<TmChart Type="ChartType.Bar"
         Data="@(new ChartData { Labels = months, Datasets = new[] {
             new ChartDataset { Label = "Rent", Values = rent, Color = "#22c55e" },
             new ChartDataset { Label = "Costs", Values = costs, Color = "#ef4444" },
             new ChartDataset { Label = "Cashflow", Values = cashflow, Color = "#3b82f6", RenderAs = ChartDatasetRenderAs.Line }
         } })"
         Height="320px" />

examples.title: Stacked bar chart: revenue split per quarter
examples.code:
<TmChart Type="ChartType.StackedBar"
         Data="@(new ChartData { Labels = quarters, Datasets = new[] {
             new ChartDataset { Label = "Licenses", Values = licenses, Color = "#3b82f6" },
             new ChartDataset { Label = "Support", Values = support, Color = "#22c55e" },
             new ChartDataset { Label = "Services", Values = services, Color = "#f59e0b" }
         } })"
         ShowLegend="true" ShowValues="true" Height="320px" />

examples.title: Waterfall chart with connectors and calculated total
examples.code:
<TmChart Type="ChartType.Waterfall"
         Data="@(new ChartData { Labels = new[] { "Opening", "Sales", "Costs" }, Datasets = new[] { new ChartDataset { Label = "Profit", Values = new[] { 100.0, 50.0, -30.0 }, Color = "#2563eb" } } })"
         WaterfallShowConnectors="true"
         WaterfallShowTotal="true"
         ShowValues="true"
         Height="320px" />
